# dnshe_dns_record (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnshe_dns_record" "record" {
  subdomain_id = "xxxxxxx"
  type         = "A"
  name         = "vvvcvvv.xx.bbroot.com"
  content      = "1.1.1.1"

}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String)
- `subdomain_id` (Number)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `line` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `ttl` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `record_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# dns_record#{subdomainId}#"{id}"  
# dns_record#500xxxx0#92xxxxx  
# 
terraform import dnshe_dns_record.test_record "dns_record#500xxxx0#92xxxxx"
```
